meta.notes: A block that lights the Sky Gate without flint and steel. Put it on the ground just in front of the opening of a finished frame (next to the bottom of the opening) and use it: msm:on_interact fires the event msm_examples:sky_gate_beacon_used, whose light_portal action lights an empty frame of msm_examples:sky_gate at the beacon or next to it. Nothing happens with no frame there. Any trigger can run light_portal: a mob's death, an item used on a block, a pressure plate. It reuses the vanilla lodestone model.
